title: Spinach & Ricotta Stuffed Shells
description: Jumbo pasta shells filled with creamy ricotta and spinach, baked under marinara and melted cheese.

ingredients.item: chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

steps.text: Boil the shells until just tender and drain.
Mix the filling and stuff each shell.
Arrange over marinara, top with sauce and cheese, and bake.

cookSteps.text: Heat oven to 375°F. Boil the jumbo shells just until al dente; drain and cool enough to handle.
Mix ricotta, half the mozzarella, Parmesan, spinach, and egg. Spoon filling into each shell.
Spread half the marinara in the baking dish. Arrange stuffed shells on top, cover with remaining sauce and mozzarella.
Cover and bake 25 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes more until bubbling.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Reheat covered until hot.

title: Homemade Turkey Meatballs & Marinara
description: Tender homemade turkey meatballs browned and gently simmered in marinara for a satisfying pasta-night dinner.

steps.text: Mix and shape the meatballs without overworking the turkey.
Brown the meatballs in a skillet.
Simmer them gently in marinara until cooked through.

cookSteps.text: Mix turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, Parmesan, and Italian seasoning. Shape into about 16 small meatballs.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Brown meatballs on several sides, about 8 minutes.
Pour in marinara, cover, and simmer gently until meatballs reach 165°F in the center, about 20–25 minutes.

storage: Refrigerate meatballs and sauce up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.

title: Vegetable Pot Pie with Biscuit Top
description: Creamy vegetables under a golden biscuit topping—a cozy dinner with a few satisfying cooking steps.

steps.text: Stir in broth, milk, vegetables, and seasoning until creamy.
Top with biscuits and bake until golden.

cookSteps.text: Heat oven to 400°F. Melt butter over medium heat, whisk in flour, and cook 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in broth and milk. Simmer until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in vegetables and thyme. Transfer to a baking dish if needed and arrange biscuits over the top.
Bake 25–30 minutes until the filling bubbles and biscuits are deeply golden.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven or microwave.

title: Mushroom & Spinach Risotto
description: Creamy rice with mushrooms, spinach, and Parmesan made by gradually stirring warm broth into the rice.

steps.text: Keep the broth warm while cooking the mushrooms.
Toast the rice, then add broth a ladle at a time while stirring.
Finish with spinach, butter, and Parmesan.

cookSteps.text: Warm broth in a saucepan and keep it at a gentle simmer.
Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a deep skillet. Cook mushrooms until tender, about 6 minutes; set aside.
Add rice to the skillet and stir 1–2 minutes. Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and waiting until mostly absorbed before adding more.
Continue about 20–25 minutes until rice is creamy and tender with a slight bite.
Stir in mushrooms, spinach, remaining butter, and Parmesan. Cook until spinach wilts, then serve.

storage: Best fresh; refrigerate leftovers up to 3 days and loosen with broth when reheating.

title: Chicken Pot Pie with Homemade Filling
description: A classic creamy chicken-and-vegetable filling baked beneath a flaky pie crust.

ingredients.item: cooked shredded or finely diced chicken

steps.text: Cook a creamy gravy and fold in chicken and vegetables.
Transfer to the pie dish and cover with crust.
Cut vents and bake until deeply golden and bubbling.

cookSteps.text: Heat oven to 400°F. Melt butter in a skillet; whisk in flour and cook 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in broth and milk. Simmer until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in chicken and vegetables. Pour into pie dish and place crust over the filling. Crimp edges and cut several steam vents.
Bake 35–40 minutes until crust is golden and filling bubbles. Rest 10 minutes before serving.
Let the pot pie rest before slicing so the filling settles.

title: Baked Eggplant Parmesan
description: Crisp baked breaded eggplant layered with marinara and cheese for a hearty meatless dinner.

steps.text: Bread the eggplant slices and bake until crisp.
Layer eggplant with marinara and cheese.

cookSteps.text: Heat oven to 425°F. Slice eggplant into 1/2-inch rounds. Dip in beaten egg, then coat with breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan.
Arrange on a sheet pan and bake 20 minutes, turning once halfway through.
Lower oven to 375°F. Layer marinara, eggplant, mozzarella, and remaining Parmesan in a baking dish.
Bake 25 minutes until hot and bubbling. Rest 5–10 minutes before serving.
